axis.description: optional, int or sequence of ints, default=None. Axis along which the mean to be computed. If None, mean is computed along all the axes. dtype: The type of the output array. If None (default) then the output dtype will be match the input dtype for floating point inputs, or be set to float32 or float64 for non-floating-point inputs.

keepdims.description: bool, default=False. If true, reduced axes are left in the result with size 1.

where.description: optional, boolean array, default=None. The elements to be used in the mean. Array should be broadcast compatible to the input.

output.description: An array of the mean along the given axis.
